It's reinforced by the bones of a large fish—a marked improvement over any standard wooden bow.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 14 |durability = 25 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lizal Bow}} Lizal Bows are [[Bow]]s wielded by regular [[Lizalfos]] in the [[Lanayru Great Spring]] and [[Lanayru Wetlands]]. [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] also use them on occasion. They were created by Lizalfos and reinforced with the bones of a large [[Fish]]. Due to their origin, they are part of the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Their composition makes them superior to the standard [[Wooden Bow]]. Being made of wood, Lizal Bows will burn and eventually disintegrate if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]] like metal [[Weapon]]s do, and they will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, they cannot be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_006" |Life = 25 |Power = 14 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Lizal Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Lizal Bows reappear in {{AoC}}, being wielded by [[Lizalfos]] during early [[Scenario]]s and [[Challenge]]s.
